summary: Suzi reveals the 3rd Anniversary daily promo code SEPTEMBER19 for 15 Heliolite Dice. She shares her account progress, including redeeming Guinavivre from the Temporal Corridor shop using 300 Dust-sealed Tomes. She discusses her setup for Option Summons focusing on Dauntless and Thunderbolt/Toxic schools, explains how to properly use Midasbuy top-up bonus vouchers alongside creator support binding, and reviews hero options inside the Legendary Hero Prime Chest II such as Phaessa, Rose, and Synarell awakenings.

tips: Redeem the code SEPTEMBER19 in all caps in-game to receive 15 Heliolite Dice.
Bind your account to a creator (such as SuziPlays) in the Treasure Market under the Monthly tab to claim extra free support rewards.
Log into the Midas website, connect your game account, and enter top-up bonus codes in the redeem section to unlock extra Dragon Crystals on store purchases.
Review the Traveler's Departure Gift tiered event shop packs ($0.99 to $19.99) for cost-effective guaranteed Legendary hero chests.
